metin.PARTY ÜYELERİNİ ARTIK DAHA DETAYLI TAKİP: TRACK YOUR PARTY MEMBERS IN MORE DETAIL!
metin.SexyKO'da party sistemi daha kullanışlı: The party system in SexyKO has become more useful and easier to control.
metin.Party içerisindeki oyuncuların hangi bil: Now **you choose** which information you want to see about the players in your party.
metin.Party panelinde bulunan ayarlar üzerinde: From the settings in the party panel:
metin.⚔️ DAMAGE BİLGİSİ seçeneklerini ayrı ayr: ⚔️ DAMAGE INFO — you can turn each of these options on or off separately.
metin.Party üyelerinizin mevcut HP durumunu an: Follow the current HP of your party members live.
metin.Party üyelerinin MP durumunu görebilir,: See your party members' MP and make control easier, especially for mage and support classes.
metin.Party üyelerinizin buff durumlarını taki: Follow the buff status of your party members.
metin.Party üyelerinin verdiği damage bilgisin: Follow the damage dealt by your party members on the party screen.
metin.Party ekranınızı tamamen **kendi oyun ta: Set up your party screen fully **to match your own play style.**
metin.İstemediğiniz bilgileri ise tek tıkla ka: And you can turn off the info you don't want with one click.
metin.SEXYKO'DA PARTY OYNAMAK ARTIK DAHA KOLAY: PLAYING IN A PARTY IN SEXYKO IS NOW EASIER!
